title: Dark Ballcap
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Dark Ballcap |image = Dark Ballcap.png |source = Desert Festival }} The '''Dark Ballcap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Dark Ballcap. ==Notes== * The Dark Ballcap outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt014.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Skeleton Shirt]] and [[File:Tight Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tight Pants]] (dyed RGB value 223,213,183). ==References== See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue".
